title: Count Subarrays With Given XOR
description: Given an array `nums` of non-negative integers and a target non-negative integer `k`, return the total number of non-empty contiguous subarrays of `nums` whose elements have a bitwise XOR equal to `k`.
hints: Maintain the running prefix XOR `pref = nums[0] ^ ... ^ nums[i]`. A subarray `(j..i]` has XOR equal to `k` if and only if `pref[j] ^ pref[i] == k`, i.e., `pref[j] == pref[i] ^ k`.
Store frequencies of all seen prefix XOR values in a hash map initialized with `{0: 1}` to count valid subarrays ending at each index in O(1) average time.

examples.explanation: The 4 subarrays with XOR 6 are [4, 2], [4, 2, 2, 6, 4], [2, 2, 6], and [6].
The 2 subarrays with XOR 5 are [5] and [5, 6, 7, 8, 9].
Every one of the 6 non-empty subarrays of [0, 0, 0] has XOR 0.
